							is_subject_of = NAM
							has_country_flag = NAM_federal_district
						}
					}
					# The holder loses its concession; the helper does not move trust.
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { NAM_board_partition_efl > 0 } }
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_company_input value = NAM_board_partition_efl }
						set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_delta_input value = -8 }
						NAM_board_support_change = yes
					}
					EFL = { NAM_mdr_absorb_district = yes }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_cons_change value = 4 }
				NAM_consolidation_add = yes
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = 4 }
				NAM_board_trust_package = yes
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.217 days = 90 random_days = 30 }
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.192 days = 2 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 1
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				NAM_rtw_direct_rule = no
			}
		}
	}

				NAM_mdr_grant_estates = yes
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = -4 }

shared_focus = {
		id = NAM_mdr_southern_railway
		icon = GFX_focus_NAM_through_waybill
		x = 11
		y = 11
		cost = 2
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY }
		prerequisite = { focus = NAM_mdr_damir_road }
		cancel_if_invalid = no
		continue_if_invalid = no
		completion_reward = {
			unlock_decision_tooltip = NAM_mdr_rail_brigades
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_mdr_rail_brigades_unlock_tt
			add_political_power = 50
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_mdr_southern_railway_reward_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				# The spur needs Damir on the Directory's or a company district's land;
				# otherwise the harbour coast gets the road and the node instead.
				if = {
					limit = {
						240 = {
							OR = {
								AND = {
									is_owned_by = ROOT
									is_controlled_by = ROOT
								}
								AND = {
									owner = {
										has_country_flag = NAM_federal_district
										is_subject_of = ROOT
									}
									controller = {
										has_country_flag = NAM_federal_district
										is_subject_of = ROOT
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					build_railway = {
						level = 2
						build_only_on_allied = yes
						fallback = yes
						start_state = 700
						target_state = 240
					}
					# "Южные округа" may already have placed the Damir node; the
					# site trigger then rejects Damir and nothing is built.
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_kind value = 7 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_levels value = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_1 value = 240 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_2 value = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_3 value = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_fallback value = 0 }
					NAM_mdr_build = yes
				}
				else = {
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_kind value = 6 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_levels value = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_1 value = 689 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_2 value = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_3 value = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_fallback value = 0 }
					NAM_mdr_build = yes
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_kind value = 7 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_levels value = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_1 value = 700 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_2 value = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_state_3 value = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_mdr_build_fallback value = 0 }
					NAM_mdr_build = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_5 value = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_board_trust_input_3 value = -3 }
				NAM_board_trust_package = yes
